title: Bag subtotal is more than ₹17,000 a pair

explanation.text: The bag subtotal is the sum of the line totals (P3) and the number of pairs is the sum of the quantities (P4); the merchant caps the subtotal at ₹17,000 per pair (S1).

assumptions: Money has two decimal places, so ₹17,000 is 1700000 minor units.
One unit of qty is one pair.
